name: Start and clear a fair beginner board
description: Verifies a phone-sized fair board opens safely, responds to taps, and allows immediate replay after a win.
steps: Tap a covered cell to begin
Use visible numbers to clear safe cells and flag mines until the board is complete
expected: The first cell and its neighbors contain no mine, the board is marked fair, the win time appears, and a fresh board is ready.

name: Flag, hint, chord, and inspect a loss
covers: pan, pinch zoom, and Fit Board
description: Exercises touch actions and confirms a lost board stays visible for inspection and exact-seed retry.
steps: Start an Expert board and pan or pinch to zoom; use Fit Board to return the full grid to view
Long-press a covered cell to flag it
Flag the required adjacent mines and tap a numbered cell to chord
If a mine is triggered, inspect the revealed board
Choose Retry board and compare the seed
expected: Flags toggle without revealing, hints identify only proven moves or say no certain move, chording follows classic rules, and Retry recreates the same seed.

name: Resume a saved game and change settings
description: Confirms a partially played game and accessibility settings survive a reload.
steps: Start a board and reveal several cells
Open Settings and enable high contrast and reduced motion
Continue the board and open statistics
expected: The same board state and elapsed time resume, selected settings remain enabled, and the difficulty statistics remain available.

name: Play the deterministic daily board and a shared seed
description: Verifies daily and seeded games can be reproduced and that the app shell is installable and cached for offline use.
steps: Record the displayed seed and complete the fair board
Open Seed, copy the seed, then enter it in Play a seed
expected: The date's daily layout and seed recur, its completion is tracked locally, and entering the copied seed recreates that board.
